name: Celestial Worldwide Livestream
summary:
Celestial Worldwide Livestream brings Celestial Church of Christ (CCC) Worldwide services to your Meta Quest, on a large screen wherever you are.

The app opens straight into whatever is on air:
- Live service: Sunday and weekday services, revivals, conventions and special programmes as they happen
- Studio 2: live programmes from the CCC Worldwide Community Hub studio
- CCC Worldwide 24/7: past services, sermons and hymns around the clock
